scope: Actual output selection controller with controlled suspended context and asynchronous resume. Not native OS sink, rendered audio or physical sockets.

checks.name: Stopped selection resumes the muted engine, selects the sink and settles stereo without any deck Play
checks.error:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ 'setSink:A'
- 'resume'

checks.name: A failed resume reports the error, never switches sink and clears the visible pending state
checks.error:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ 'AssertionError'
- 'NotAllowedError'

checks.name: Disposal while resume is pending cannot select a sink or reopen physical output afterward
checks.error:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ {
+   error: 'A suspended sink must not be switched before resume\n' +
+     '+ actual - expected\n' +
+     '\n' +
+     "+ 'suspended'\n" +
+     "- 'running'\n"
+ }
- false

checks.name: A newer selection supersedes a pending resume before any obsolete sink switch
checks.error:
Expected values to be strictly equal:
+ actual - expected

+ {
+   error: 'A suspended sink must not be switched before resume\n' +
+     '+ actual - expected\n' +
+     '\n' +
+     "+ 'suspended'\n" +
+     "- 'running'\n"
+ }
- false
